trace.question: For the patient who was diagnosed with SLE on 1994/2/19, what was his/her anti-Cardiolipin antibody concentration status on 1993/11/12?
trace.evidence: diagnosed with SLE refers to Diagnosis = 'SLE'; 1994/2/19 refers to Description = '1994-02-19'; anti-Cardiolipin refers to aCL IgM; 1993/11/12 refers to Examination Date = '1993/11/12'

attempts.sql:
SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND REPLACE(E.`Examination Date`, '/', '-') = '1993-11-12'

verdicts.text:
The date literal `'1993/11/12'` likely doesn't match the stored format. `Description` is given in hyphenated form (`'1994-02-19'`), so `Examination Date` is probably stored as `'1993-11-12'` too. Normalizing the slashes in the comparison keeps the filter correct either way.

```sql
SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND REPLACE(E.`Examination Date`, '/', '-') = '1993-11-12'
```

trace.final_sql:
SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND REPLACE(E.`Examination Date`, '/', '-') = '1993-11-12'
trace.answer: The patient's anti-Cardiolipin IgM concentration on 1993/11/12 was 4.1.
